TEXT: AGRICULTURAL RISK MANAGEMENT
# Risk Management, Backed by Science
Aanika is an insurance MGA and program administrator operated by a team of scientists and financial professionals. We deliver risk solutions for agriculture through proprietary science and technology.
BACKING
## Rated Carrier Capacity
Aanika's programs are backed by large, highly rated carriers who provide the capacity and financial strength to deliver reliable, comprehensive coverage across all of our offerings.
SOLUTIONS
## Our Capabilities
Credit Insurance
Comprehensive protection for agricultural organizations offering input credit, backed by large, highly rated carriers.
LEARN MORE
Warranty Programs
Tailored warranty solutions for agricultural retailers and manufacturers with science-based underwriting.
Spray Drift Coverage
Property-damage protection for herbicide drift incidents, powered by advanced detection technology.
OUR PHILOSOPHY
## We believe that superior science creates superior outcomes.
Our interdisciplinary team of scientists, actuaries, and technologists work to quantify and mitigate agricultural risk with unprecedented precision.

TEXT: # Our Products
Institutional-grade risk management solutions powered by science and technology.
01
PROTECTION FOR AGRICULTURAL LENDERS BACKED BY LARGE, HIGHLY RATED CARRIERS
Our flagship product provides comprehensive coverage for agricultural organizations offering input credit. Backed by large, highly rated carriers, we use proprietary risk analytics and advanced data modeling to underwrite and manage lender exposure with institutional-grade precision.
KEY FEATURES
- Protect your balance sheet from input credit defaults
- Extend more credit to growers with confidence
- Reduce capital reserves tied to credit risk
- Strengthen grower relationships through flexible financing
02
FOR RETAILERS & MANUFACTURERS
Tailored warranty solutions for agricultural retailers and manufacturers. Our science-based underwriting combines field trial data, environmental analysis, and performance modeling to structure coverage that aligns with product performance.
- Performance guarantee structures
- Seed and input warranties
- Custom program design
- White-label solutions available
03
PROPERTY DAMAGE PROTECTION PRODUCT IN DEVELOPMENT
Specialized coverage for herbicide drift incidents. Our team combines on-ground sampling and BioTag molecular analysis to assess damage quickly and accurately, enabling fair and efficient claims resolution.
- Rapid damage assessment
- Molecular verification of drift source
- Coverage for applicators and affected parties
- Expert claims management
